name: screenshot-game-view
description: Captures the Game View as a PNG, longest side 960 px. left/top/right/bottom (0..1, top-left origin) zoom into a region. To click what you see, pass its 0..1 PNG position to ui-runtime-click/drag/probe with space:"screenshot", plus the same left/top/right/bottom if cropped. pixelMappingReliable:false = letterboxed: target by path/instanceId. storyboard:true: last minute of Play in one image (the first call may just start recording).

left.description: Left edge of the region to capture, 0..1 of the full view width. Omit all four edges for the whole view.

top.description: Top edge of the region, 0..1 of the full view height, top-left origin (0 is the top of the screen).

right.description: Right edge of the region, 0..1; must be greater than left.

bottom.description: Bottom edge of the region, 0..1, top-left origin; must be greater than top.

savePath.description: Optional path to also write the resulting PNG to disk. Accepts an absolute path (e.g. C:/Shots/view.png) or a path relative to the Unity project folder (e.g. ./Temp/view.png). Parent folders are created as needed.

storyboard.description: Play Mode: the frame recorder's last minute (a frame every 0.5 s) as one image of up to 30 frames, marked frames always in, with a legend of times and per-frame state. The first call starts recording and returns no image.
